preset.purpose: The frame budget with a body in the scene: the movement showcase's run (same input script, same cuts, same camera) with no frame strip and without the course's one-metre grid (its lines are work for the anti-aliasing pass, not for the body), so nothing but the game is in the frame times. Also the run the benchmark mode carries to other machines; its end-state hash says whether the run played out the same there.

tick_cost_ms.what: wall time of one tick's scripts: every body's move and the instruments watching them
